headline: Libya Pipeline Closures Cut Sharara and Hamada Oil Field Output by 350,000 bpd
summary: Pipeline closures at Libya's Sharara and Hamada oil fields have reduced crude production by 350,000 barrels per day. The combined output losses represent roughly a quarter of Libya's total October crude production.
why: Libya is a major supplier of high-quality light sweet crude to European refineries, making its domestic supply outages impactful for Mediterranean oil markets.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: The sudden loss of 350,000 barrels per day of crude supply reduces global market availability.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Unplanned pipeline shutdowns forcibly curtailed Libya's daily crude output by 25%.
